title: Staged Endpoint Order Re-Quote of a Cancelled Endpoint Line: Price Build-Up
content:
## Build-up of the re-quote total

A Hardware Procurement staged re-quote of a cancelled endpoint line takes the line of a Standard Endpoint Order cancelled after its purchase order onto a Staged Endpoint Order quote for the same part number and quantity. Its unit price is the cancelled order's unit price carried over unchanged.

The staged re-quote total is the units of the cancelled line times the carried-over unit price, plus an imaging charge of **95.00 USD** for each unit, plus a staged handling charge of **25.00 USD**, plus a staged rush charge of **150.00 USD** when the cancelled order was quoted with rush, plus a security preparation charge of **15.00 USD** for each unit, with nothing deducted.

Every charge of the re-quote is figured and summed. The staged re-quote total is rounded half up to the cent once, on the final amount.

| Line of the build-up | Amount | Read from |
|---|---|---|
| Units | units of the cancelled line times its unit price, carried over unchanged | the cancelled order's quantity and unit price |
| Imaging | 95.00 for each unit | |
| Staged handling | 25.00 once | |
| Staged rush | 150.00 once, only when the cancelled order was quoted with rush | the cancelled order's rush flag |
| Security preparation | 15.00 for each unit | |

### Worked example (hypothetical figures)

A hypothetical cancelled line of 6 units at a unit price of 1000.00, quoted with rush:

1. Units: 6 times 1000.00, that is 6000.00.
2. Imaging: 6 times 95.00, that is 570.00.
3. Staged handling: 25.00.
4. Staged rush: 150.00.
5. Security preparation: 6 times 15.00, that is 90.00.

The total is 6835.00. Had the cancelled order been quoted without rush, it would be 6685.00.
